page0.text:
There's a time and place for complete honesty.
Just thinking back to that dream was enough to make me blush, and if I described it out loud, I'm pretty sure I'd pass out from the ensuing fever.

page1.text:
"Senpai, who was in your dream?"
"Nobody, really! You know, people forget dreams as soon as they wake up, so it's not like I still remember everything."

page2.text: "Oh? I'm curious what you do remember, though."

page3.text:
"You...!"
Sh-she suddenly gets more aggressive, closing in on me after I've retreated from my futon.

page4.text:
"H-hey, please don't get any closer! I'm begging you, this topic is off limits!!!"
I wave my hands in the air frantically and roll on the ground.

page5.text:
Damn it. I really do need to train more.
Until now, I've always managed to not be too conscious of her, but thanks to that damn dream, every single move Sakura makes is setting me off!

page6.text:
"P-please, just leave me alone for a while. Shouldn't you listen to what a sick person asks for!?"
I take up position in a corner of the room and entreat Sakura.

page7.text:
"...Whew. All right. I won't pry.
I really am curious about your dream, but I'm afraid it would raise your fever to push you on it."
Sakura retreats in disappointment.

page8.text:
"Sorry. But thanks for being considerate."
I eagerly return to bed.

page9.text:
"Then, Senpai, I'm off to make lunch now.
I'll come get you when it's ready, so please take it easy until then."
"Oh, right. Thanks."
